use_case_summary: Mid-market commerce SaaS using semantic search + reranking for product discovery and a conversational support assistant. Primary workload: low-latency chat for customers and high-throughput embeddings for nightly catalog indexing. Looking for EU data residency and predictable per-request latency for EU users.
notes: Background: Celestial Vine runs a B2B marketplace platform (catalog + search + support). Engineering-led evaluation: product team (CTO: Jonas Pettersson) and infra lead (Sabrina Kaur).
Initial path: started with Redwood hosted API to speed integration and validate latency/cost, then asked for Dedicated for capacity predictability and EU data residency.
Quote from demo (2026-02-18): 'Hosted was quick to spin up and showed promise, but we need EU-only data at rest and stricter audit logs before we can go live.'
Security: heavy emphasis on DPA language, data residency (EU), customer PII retention policies, and KMS integration for key management. Legal requested example DPA and SOC2 evidence.
Commercial: mid-market ARR expectation 100k-250k tied to a 12-month committed Dedicated pool. Sensitive to unit cost on embeddings due to nightly reindexing of 5M product descriptions.

Technical: measured P95 token gen latency (hosted eu-west endpoint) 95ms for short chat prompts; engineering target P95 < 80ms for UI feel. Embedding qps target ~300 qps during batch windows; acceptable to ramp with autoscaling for Dedicated.

Routing: want primary EU region (eu-west-1) with failover to NA only for region outages; concerned about cross-region routing adding 30-60ms for certain flows. Discussed routing policy that pins EU users to EU-hosted model variants and falls back to lower-cost variants in NA if capacity constrained.

POC notes: hosted POC integrated into staging catalog, synthetic load tests with 500 concurrent chat users and nightly embedding pipeline ran successfully on hosted but cost spikes noted during rebuilds. Team wants a Dedicated offering for predictable performance and lower per-token cost.

Procurement: procurement + legal looping in; finance asked for 3 pricing scenarios (hosted with reserved commit credit, Dedicated small pool, Dedicated large pool with burst). We provided preliminary quotes 2026-03-03.
Next meeting: procurement review call scheduled 2026-03-22 (finance + legal + Maya + Diego). Action: provide EU-region SLA, sample DPA, and detailed cost projection for 12/24 month Dedicated commit.
